failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of acetonitrile exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 40°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure
Install inline filter and regularly clean BPR valve

failure_modes.cause: Fouling of reactor walls or lamp degradation
failure_modes.mitigation: Regularly clean reactor and replace lamp as per maintenance schedule

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.5 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR valve with particulate-laden solvent to assess blockage risk
Measure photon flux at reactor exit to ensure consistent delivery over time
